lesson_evidence.target: I can choose and carry out a sensible numerical strategy and explain why my answer is reasonable.
lesson_evidence.evidence_note: Independent evidence after instruction, practice and feedback.

lesson_evidence.target: I can evaluate numerical expressions and translate simple verbal phrases into expressions with unknowns.
lesson_evidence.evidence_note: This is early/partial evidence only; do not infer full Proficient.

lesson_evidence.target: I can collect like terms and use algebra-tile or area representations to explain simplification.
lesson_evidence.evidence_note: Independent evidence after instruction, practice and feedback.

lesson_evidence.target: I can evaluate an expression by substituting a value for its variable.
lesson_evidence.evidence_note: Independent evidence after instruction, practice and feedback.

assessment_design.practice: mix direct with spiral; use 2+ current-chapter items
assessment_design.quick_check: 2 direct and 1 reasoning item from introduced/expected targets; teacher reviews results
assessment_design.checkpoint: cover 2+ distinct lesson targets, including explanation
assessment_design.test: sample taught chapter evidence plus prior rechecks; report proficiency only for EXPECT targets
assessment_design.custom: select any approved source cards plus active bank exemplars
assessment_design.feedback_recheck: new comparable response after feedback, not the same exact question
